supervisor.value: A supportive faculty member is best advocate for admission and funding consideration.
supervisor.quote: A faculty member who is excited about having you at UF as a graduate student is your best advocate! | To be considered for UF Fellowships or Teaching Assistantships, you must apply by the December 15th application deadline.

funding.value: Tuition is covered for everyone on a TA or RA.
funding.quote: Please note, that tuition is covered for everyone on a TA or RA.

entry_route.value: Direct admission from bachelor's degree with upper-division GPA of at least 3.0.
entry_route.quote: For applicants with solely a bachelor’s degree, a minimum 3.0 GPA on all coursework completed after the applicant has earned 60 semester hours (90 quarter hours) is required.
